descriptions.w3d_cc29b_lock_text_8018d4bc: Computes the signed halfword-range count, touches the held resource, then locks the single or doubled-count storage according to mode. Reuses kind-one storage with matching count by incrementing its 16-bit lock count; otherwise calls the native lock helper with width four. Doubled mode returns the second count-sized word span. Types describe observed fields only.
